“Shura Martial God Synopsis: Adapted from the novel of the same name, the story follows a young man who has suffered bullying from his family. He starts as an ordinary outer disciple of the Qinglong Sect, a second-tier sect in the mortal realm. Through a fortunate encounter, he obtains the power of the Nine-Colored Divine Thunder and discovers that he harbors an even stronger power sealed within him. Through continuous cultivation and the companionship of Su Mei, Su Rou, and others, Chu Feng’s strength grows steadily. However, he never expected that his cultivation talent would arouse the jealousy of Gong Luyun, the genius of the Qinglong Sect. They make a bet for life and death, agreeing to a battle one year later…”
